none: PAS NCL-09C0C5: NCL-09C0C5: A damaged lead weight, probably of Roman date.
contea di ritrovamento: Northumberland (Inghilterra e Galles)

A damaged lead weight, probably of Roman date. The weight is sub-cylindrical in shape, with damage distorting the overall shape. A triangular groove runs 16.3mm down one side. The top is missing, so it cannot be determined if the weight had a suspension loop. The base is uneven in texture and somewhat flat. Four inscribed lines decorate the body of the weight, with the two central lines separated…
